title: NTV Android TV v1.5.1
changelog:
• 100% EPG Coverage Across 1,226 Channels: Fixed EPG data missing on channels by expanding XMLTV parser retention window to 72 hours, preventing premature purging of once-daily community feeds.
• 24h & 48h Recurring Schedule Projection: Automatically projects past day show schedules onto today's active timeline, guaranteeing full Now/Next program titles, descriptions, and live progress bars 24/7.
• Enhanced Channel Name & Alias Matching: Intelligent fuzzy resolution for Zee, Sony Sports Ten, and regional network channels.
• Inherits all v1.5 optimizations: Hardware-first decoding, RGB_565 GPU bitmaps, Zee channel zapping Akamai 403 fix, and Compose 60fps stability.
